picks.what: View over the southern part of the town, postcard
picks.why: colored view from a height over the town toward its churches; printed caption trimmed

gaps: P0–P3: nothing of the town (unrelated Calvary hits, an icon, a coat of arms); P5: nothing; P6: only plaques and a single building
notes: Record dates #10 only as before October 1917 (prerevolutionary spelling); ‘about 1910’ is an estimate from the postcard style. #12 (view from the harbor) is a weaker alternative from the same series.
